clips.title: The story
paras: Gordon Wendham is a Forsaken weaponsmith and merchant operating out of the bustling Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He equips newly arrived champions and local defenders of the Dark Lady with reliable steel, blades, and bludgeons. Beyond hawking basic armaments, he frequently serves as a local point of contact for couriers arriving from the surface.

Situated amidst the damp stonework and chemical canals of the Undercity's Trade Quarter, Gordon Wendham provides essential weaponry to those taking up arms for the Forsaken. From basic daggers and hand axes to sturdy broadswords and maces, his stock caters to fledgling fighters who need dependable iron before venturing out into the contested reaches of Lordaeron.

Beyond his merchant trade, Wendham is integrated into the capital's busy logistics network. Travelers sent on errands from flight masters and couriers—such as those connecting from the bat handlers atop the ruins—are often directed straight to his stall. His central location in the Trade Quarter makes him an accessible and recognizable fixture for coordinating basic supplies and dispatches throughout the underground city.
